source_native.change_notice: Original source materials unchanged; absent glTF metallicFactor defaults to1 and is a known organic-material limitation.

organic_dielectric_v1.change_notice: Declared runtime material adaptation: metalness=0 on all three cloned materials. The selected eye-UV-v1 derivative changes only eye TEXCOORD_0 and its bounds plus derivative notice, affecting both existing eye base-color and metallic-roughness UV maps as runtime uses them. All six embedded image payloads, material records, roughnessFactor0.6, opacity, double-sided policy, geometry, body/hair UVs, rig and clip are exact b479 bytes/semantics. Opaque hair and baked coat highlights remain; no native or photographic acceptance.

budget_proposal.limits: Conservative first intake caps, not measured device/frame-time acceptance. Phone-light fetches no GLB; actual balanced phone memory/frame checks still required.

known_quality_limits: Stocky stylized anatomy; not a historically identified breed or individual.
Solid mane and pointed opaque sheet tail, coarse/near-closed eyes,1K coat; not photographic master.
Source default four-foot minimum height difference~5.24mm normalized; upright yard gaps max5.771mm unaccepted. Proposed whole-root support rotation handled explicitly by placement data.
Actual source-surface hoof annotations and bounded sample checks are not certified anatomical soles, bones or coupling sockets.
Modern source author publication does not attest Chicago date, owner, measurements, phenotype, grooming or tack.

Eye UV v1 reconstructs coherent dark brown iris/pupil placement on the unchanged near-closed source globes; gaze and approximately horizontal pupil are authored choices, not measured equine anatomy or historical identity. Same-camera CPU diagnostic was reviewed; actual browser PBR, close eye detail and mobile inspection remain unqualified.

contact_annotation_history.supersession: The original receipt grounding method forbids pitch and describes the preserved upright exploration ONLY. The proposed static stand explicitly supersedes that placement restriction with the later reconstructed whole-root Rz(roll)*Rx(pitch) support transform below the heading wrapper. Original source binary/internal rig/default pose, scale and all source contact annotations remain unchanged. Original upright5.771mm gap is not accepted. No per-limb deformation or gait is enabled.

finite_sample_qualification.note: MINIMUM per-foot gap does not mean the complete curved underside lies flat. These finite samples do not certify continuous support/contact/anatomy.

ground_support.snapshot: Exact actual yard-worn_earth drawn triangle copies retained before normal coarse upload release, max32triangles/4096typed-array bytes for one ≤4m² rectangle. No whole-town array retention, no RELEASE_KEEP change, no ?keep-geometry.
ground_support.status: Pre-upload bounded snapshot source and finite real-Three CPU release regression reviewed; actual published-yard coarse count/bytes/gaps remain to be inspected.

transcribes.note: Carries all four Western Hotel claims in this dataset — the farmers' and teamsters' house, W. H. Stow as builder and proprietor, the original two storeys, and the large stable and wagon yard with entrances from both streets — and it carries the dispute over the build date that keeps the dated range at `inferred`. Men recalling a house they used: rung 2.
